First, convert 12-07-1440 (Hijri date) to Gregorian date.  
12-07-1440 AH = 1440-12-07 AH.  
Using conversion: 1440-12-07 AH ≈ 2019-07-14 CE (since 1440 AH started around Aug 2018, and 12th month is Dhul-Hijjah).  

Add 27 weeks 3 days = 27×7 + 3 = 192 days.  
2019-07-14 + 192 days:  
July: 17 days left (31-14) → 17 days.  
August: 31 days → total 48 days.  
September: 30 days → total 78 days.  
October: 31 days → total 109 days.  
November: 30 days → total 139 days.  
December: 31 days → total 170 days.  
Remaining: 192 - 170 = 22 days into 2020 → 2020-01-22.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 2020-01-22
